verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to opt out of Sentry's own telemetry or usage tracking (for example of the SDK, CLI, or self-hosted instance). The only related evidence is data-collection controls for AI prompt and response content: `include_prompts=False`, `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs`, and prompt content being off by default. Those are an adjacent feature that limits what monitoring data gets captured, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
